title: Keep the last MRC checkpoint in upper-bank CMOS E0-E9 and freeze it when a pass dies
limits: Diagnostic, not a correction. Completed-pass logging was observed once on one MR9A PRO V1.2; retention of a failed pass is not validated (a no-RAM POST 53 attempt left no failed record, cause unresolved). Records MRC only: BF ends tracking, later errors such as no-GPU d6 are out of scope. Best effort: no checksum, not reset-atomic, not synchronized with other CMOS writers. Uses the NOP runs freed by B01-B06 and replaces the old port-80 writer, so other patches to UncoreInitPeim must be composed before it, not on top of it. Read E0-E9 with `bme diag breadcrumbs read` before clearing CMOS.
